trust_decision.summary: Whether a state-changing (non-GET) request carrying an ambient OAuth session cookie really comes from Flower's own UI. At the pinned commit, BaseHandler.get_current_user accepts the 'user' secure cookie alone. The Tornado app settings have no xsrf_cookies, so nothing decides it. The fix enables xsrf_cookies globally and decides it in BaseHandler.check_xsrf_cookie, which skips the check when auth is unset or an Authorization header is present.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'Worker and Task Control API Endpoints', and WorkerShutDown.post on ControlHandler is the first control endpoint (the fix's tests also hit /api/worker/shutdown).

fix_sites.entry_point: every non-GET HTTP route in flower/urls.py:22-65 (application settings dict passed via flower/command.py:48)
BaseHandler: check_xsrf_cookie override with exemptions, xsrf_token set in render() for every page (GET /, /workers, /tasks ...), set_secure_cookie default flags used by /login handlers
browser UI AJAX POSTs (ajaxSetup adds the X-XSRFToken header to every non-GET call)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: flower/static/js/flower.js:178-179 (client JS has to echo the token); flower/views/__init__.py:30-36 (render() must issue the _xsrf cookie); flower/views/tasks.py:76-78 (UI DataTable POST, a read-only POST that also becomes guarded)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Requests carrying an Authorization header (Basic auth / API scripts) and servers with no auth look like they 'cannot be forged', so a solver either leaves them alone or, the other way, applies the token check globally and breaks API clients and the UI. A solver patching ControlHandler can also argue that the task routes in api/tasks.py (apply/send-task/abort) are 'task API, not control'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Header-authenticated API clients (basic_auth) and FLOWER_UNAUTHENTICATED_API scripts must keep POSTing without a token. The UI's own AJAX POSTs, including the read-only /tasks/datatable POST, must keep working. The _xsrf cookie must stay readable (not HttpOnly) while session cookies get HttpOnly and SameSite.

O6_input_shapes: token in the X-XSRFToken header (the UI path, fix.diff:35)
token in the _xsrf form/body argument or X-CSRFToken header (accepted by Tornado's own check_xsrf_cookie, not by flower code)
request with an Authorization header: exempt (fix.diff:75-76)
all non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS methods (POST, plus PUT/DELETE/PATCH if routed)

O7_producer.where: flower/urls.py:13-19 is the settings dict that flower/command.py:123-131 extends and flower/command.py:48 passes into Flower(**settings); Tornado reads xsrf_cookies from it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/workers?refresh=1 triggers a broker-wide worker inspection with only cookie auth; GET is exempt from the token check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a GET 'list' endpoint and refresh only re-reads state, not a control action
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (flower/api), different file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: With both --auth and --basic_auth set, the browser re-sends cached Basic credentials automatically, so the Authorization-header exemption skips the token check for cookie sessions
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Combined basic+OAuth is an unusual combination, and the published fix explicitly exempts any Authorization header (fix.diff:75-76)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the published check; the cause is in get_current_user's auth-mode layering

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a login/logout handler that clears or sets the 'user' cookie through a POST, or a custom auth_provider that subclasses tornado.web.RequestHandler instead of BaseHandler and so misses the cookie-flag override
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: LoginHandler instantiates an arbitrary class from options.auth_provider, and docs/auth.rst:145-147 only suggests inheriting from BaseHandler

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a WebSocket/event-stream handler (Flower historically had /update-dashboard WebSockets) that does not inherit BaseHandler or overrides check_xsrf_cookie
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Older Flower versions shipped WebSocket dashboard updates. Tornado's WebSocketHandler skips xsrf and needs its own check_origin.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a BaseApiHandler-level check_xsrf_cookie that exempts more broadly (e.g. when FLOWER_UNAUTHENTICATED_API is set even though --auth is on)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: prepare() already branches on FLOWER_UNAUTHENTICATED_API, so a maintainer could plausibly tie the exemption to it

O9_family: CWE-352 CSRF (missing anti-forgery token on cookie-authenticated state-changing API; cookie SameSite hardening)

O10_build.language: Python (the candidate's 'JavaScript' label comes from the flower.js change)
O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10 (setup.py:56), pip, tornado>=6.5.7,<7 and celery>=5.0.5 (requirements/default.txt:1-2); tox envs in tox.ini
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit (AsyncHTTPTestCase with mock_option, post helpers): tests/unit/api/test_control.py, tests/unit/api/test_tasks.py, tests/unit/api/test_auth.py, tests/unit/views/test_auth.py; the fix adds tests/unit/views/test_xsrf.py and test_cookies.py, both absent at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set xsrf_cookies=True (or add a token check in ControlHandler.prepare) with no exemptions and no client change. That breaks Basic-auth/unauthenticated API scripts and the UI's AJAX POSTs; a ControlHandler-only check misses the task apply/send/abort routes in flower/api/tasks.py.

out_of_scope_notes: Google/GitHub/GitLab login handlers send no OAuth 'state' parameter (login CSRF), unlike Okta (flower/views/auth.py:41-56 vs 303-327). That is a separate protection, not pursued.
get_current_user uses re.match(options.auth, user) while login uses authenticate() with fullmatch (flower/views/__init__.py:94 vs flower/views/auth.py:19-25). Identity-matching mismatch, not pursued.
Wildcard CORS headers are sent when neither auth mode is set (flower/views/__init__.py:18-24). Out of scope because there is no credential to forge.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no du run); Flower is a small project, and tiny_repo may apply

O1 = 14 POST API handlers: 10 in flower/api/control.py (7 worker + revoke/timeout/rate-limit) and 4 in flower/api/tasks.py (apply/async-apply/send-task/abort), routed at flower/urls.py:33-53. The read-only /tasks/datatable POST is not counted.
Whether browsers send cached Basic credentials on a cross-site form POST in the combined auth mode was reasoned from protocol behaviour, not tested
